summary: Suitcase lost on a connecting flight
story: I flew from Milwaukee to Prague with a connection in Frankfurt. My suitcase never arrived in Prague. I reported it at the airport before I left the baggage hall, and Northwind Airlines searched for three weeks before declaring it lost. They have paid me $400 in compensation. I am claiming the suitcase and what was in it. I have listed the contents with what I paid for each item, and I have receipts for everything except the shirts and the toiletry kit.

documents.name: Northwind Airlines lost baggage report
documents.content: Northwind Airlines property irregularity report PRG-NW-48213, filed June 21, 2026 at Prague airport by passenger Tom Becker. One checked bag, tag NW 771204, not delivered.

documents.name: Northwind Airlines settlement letter
documents.content: Northwind Airlines, July 13, 2026. Dear Mr. Becker, after a search of 21 days we have declared your bag lost. We have paid $400.00 to your card in full settlement of our liability.

documents.name: Purchase receipts
documents.content: Hartmann Luggage, March 2025, hard-shell suitcase: $280.00. Lakeshore Tailors, October 2025, wool suit: $420.00. Lakeshore Tailors, October 2025, leather dress shoes: $160.00. Badger Running Company, April 2026, running shoes: $110.00.
